title: Bundle Up! Hat, Scarf, Mittens, Boots | Clothes for Kids with Tiko & Pip
whyCare: Clothing words are a core toddler vocabulary set and cold-weather season is starting; 'winter clothes' Shorts are among the most-viewed kids Shorts of the year.

evidence.claim: Kidshire 'Winter Clothes for Kids' 1,662,772,097 views (0:22, ~7 months)
DarDar 'Winter Style Play!' 1,274,561,720 views (0:13); 'Learning Winter Clothes!' 524,524,440 views (both ~10 months)
YouTube quality principles reward life skills and a complete narrative in made-for-kids content

angle: Learning goal: name 4 warm clothes. Story: a chilly breeze, Tiko shivers ('brrr', brief); Pip flies in each item one at a time - hat, scarf, mittens, boots - and the child names it before the reveal (pause-and-guess). Tiko does a warm happy jump; Pip gets a tiny scarf too. Ends: 'Hat, scarf, mittens, boots - ready to play!'
hook: Whoosh! A chilly wind - 'Brrr! Tiko is cold!'
strengths: Proven billion-view concept; seasonal from now through winter; fox-cub ears and tail make the hat moment cute
weaknesses: Very saturated by huge channels; needs 4 new clothing props on the rig; must not copy Kidshire's layout
